pages.title: Food for the walk
text: Not every meal carries a tribe's [boon](tribe_dishes). Camp fare is what a walker packs: cheap, quick at the [Hearth Pot](hearth_pot), and each made for one job. Most mix the March's crops with what any farm grows.
- **Drover's Flatbread**: Steppe Grain ×2, wheat. Two to a pot, 5 hunger each, stacks to 64. The cheapest way to stay fed.
- **Glimmer Crisps**: Glimmer Bean ×2, dried kelp. Three to a pot, 3 hunger, and **eaten in a moment**, so you can snatch a bite between blows.
- **Hunter's Skewer**: any raw meat, Emberroot, beetroot. Two to a pot, 6 hunger and **Speed for 20 seconds**, to run your game down.

pages.title: Food for the walk, continued
text: - **Steppe Pemmican**: any cooked meat, Frostberry, sweet berries. Three to a pot, only 4 hunger but the best saturation for its size: it keeps you full longest on a long march.
- **Frostberry Preserve**: Frostberry ×2, sugar, in a glass bottle. 4 hunger and **Fire Resistance for 30 seconds**, for crossing the Ember Wastes. The bottle comes back.
- **Thistle Tea**: Ley Thistle, March Leaf, honeycomb, in a glass bottle. Little food, but you can drink it when full, and it **cures poison, hunger and nausea**: the camp's answer to a bad meal.
- **Highland Crumble**: an apple, Steppe Grain, sweet berries, sugar. 6 hunger and **Jump Boost for 45 seconds** for the ridges.
